semantics: Harness imports that do not point strictly down the layer order in packages/harness/AGENTS.md "Layer order" (HARNESS_LAYERS in src/test-kernel/architecture/subsystemEdgeRatchet.vitest.ts), keyed by top-level directory of packages/harness/src (`entries` is the package entry files at its root). A row is an upward import, an import within one layer, or either half of a two-way directory pair. The kind is value when any import for the pair is a runtime import; otherwise it is type-only. The ratchet fails on an unlisted row, and on a type-only row that gains a value import. A row that now points down, has only type-only imports, or is gone fails until it is shrunk here (`npx vitest run src/test-kernel/architecture/subsystemEdgeRatchet.vitest.ts -u`).
